Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act, may be called the Sindh Judicial
Academy Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
2 . Definition.‑In this
Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context‑‑
(a) "Academy" means
the Judicial Academy established under section 3;
(b) "Board" means the Board of Governors of
the Academy constituted under section 5;
(c) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of‑ the Board, and includes a person authorised by him to
perform all or any of his functions;
(d) "Director‑General"
means .the Director‑General of the Academy and includes a person
authorised by the Chairman to perform all or any of the functions of the
Director‑General;
(e) "Government"
means the Government of Sindh;
(f) "Member of the
subordinate judiciary" means a District and Sessions Judge, Additional
District and Sessions Judge, Senior Civil Judge and Assistant Sessions Judge;
Civil Judge and Judicial Magistrate wherever he may be;
(g) "Regulations"
means regulations made under this Act.

Establishment of the academy

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
3. Establishment of the Academy.‑‑(1) As from the
commencement of this Act, there shall be established for car‑tying out
the purposes of this Act, an Academy to be known as the Sindh Judicial Academy.
(2) The Academy shall be a body
corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal with power to acquire,
hold and dispose of property, both movable and immovable and shall by the name
specified in subsection (I) sue and be sued.
(3) The headquarters of the
Academy shall be at Karachi.

Functions of the academy

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
4. Functions of the Academy.‑The functions of the Academy shall
be‑‑
(a) legal orientation, training
of members of the subordinate judiciary, law officers and members of the‑bar.
(b) continuing education of
members of the subordinate judiciary;
(c) holding of conferences,
seminars, workshops and ‑ symposia for improvement of judicial system and
quality of judicial work;
(d) providing information on
legal and constitutional research;
(e) to conduct departmental
examinations of members of establishment of subordinate Courts and the High
Court;
(f) publishing of journals,
memories, research papers or reports; and
(g) performing such other
incidental functions as may be approved by the
Board or as may be requisite to further its objectives.

Board

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
5. Board.‑(1) The
general direction and the administration of the affairs of the Academy shall
vest in a Board, constituted under subsection (2).
(2) The Board shall consist of‑
(i) The Chief Justice, High Court of Sindh. Chairman
(ii) The Senior Puisne Judge, High Court
of Sindh.
Vice‑Chairman
(iii) The Attorney‑General of Pakistan Member
(iv) Minister of Law . Member
(v) Advocate‑General, Sindh Member
(vi) One District and Sessions Judge,
nominated by the Chief Justice,
High Court of Sindh. Member
(vii) One Senior Member of the Bar
nominated by the Chief Justice, .
High Court of Sindh Member
(viii) One Principal of a Law College,
nominated by the Chief Justice,
High Court of Sindh Member
(ix) The Secretary, Law Department
Government of Sindh. Member
(x) A renowned scholar nominated
by the Chief Justice High Court Sindh Member
(xi) The Registrar, High Court Sindh Member
(xii) The Director‑General of the Academy Member/Secretary
(3) The existence of a vacancy
in, or defect in the constitution of, the Board shall, not invalidate any act
or proceedings of the Board.
(4) The term of office of the
members of the Board, other than ex officio members, shall, unless removed
earlier, be three years.

Powers and the functions of the board

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
6.. Powers and the functions of
the Board.‑‑For carrying out
the purposes of the Academy, the Board shall inter alia‑‑
(a) exercise general
supervision over the affairs‑of the Academy;
(b) lay down the policy and
programme for legal orientation, continuing education and training of members
of the subordinate judiciary, law officers and members of the bar and approve
courses of training;
(c) examine and evaluate the
activities of the Academy;
(d) consider and approve the
budget estimates;
(e) receive grants‑in‑aid
from the Federal Government, Provincial Government or aid‑giving
agencies;
(f) cause proper books of
accounts to be maintained for all sums of money received and expanded by the
Academy and arrange for their audit by the Accountant‑General, Sindh;
(g) create, abolish and suspend
posts;
(h) prescribed duties of the
member's of, the staff of the Academy;
(i) appoint, suspend, punish
and remove from service any member of such staff; .
(j) purchase, hire, construct
or alter any building for the Academy;
(k) regulate; determine and
administer all matters concerning, the Academy; and
(1) decide any other matter
ancillary and incidental to the facilities of the Academy or any matter which
the Director‑General may bring to the notice of the Board.

Delegation of powers

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
7. Delegation of powers.‑‑The
Board may delegate all or any of its power and functions to the Chairman, any
member of the Board or the Director -General:
Provided that the Director‑General
may, in any emergency which in his opinion requires immediate action, take such
action with the prior approval of the Chairman.

Appointment of advisers consultants etc

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
8. Appointment of advisers,
consultants, etc.‑‑The Board may appoint any person as adviser,
consultant or expert on such terms and conditions as it may determine.

Resignation from membership etc

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
9. Resignation from membership, etc.‑‑(1)
Any member of the Board, other than an ex officio member, may at any time, by
writing under his hand addressed to the Chairman resin his office.
(2) Any casual vacancy in the
office of a member other than an ex officio member, shall be filled in through
nomination by the Chairman for the unexpired period of the term of the member.

Meetings of the board

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
10.‑‑(1) The
meetings of the Board shall be called by the Chairman:
Provided that not 'more than a
period of six months shall intervene between two meetings of the Board.
(2) The Chairman or, in his absence,
the Vice‑Chairman, shall preside at a meeting of the Board.
(3) The quorum for the meetings
of the Board shall be five members.
(4) The Board may, from time to
time, appoint such working groups of persons, from amongst its members or
otherwise, as it may consider necessary and give them specific assignments
related to the functions of the Academy.

Director-general

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
11. Director‑General.‑‑(1)
The Director‑General shall be appointed by the Board on such terms and
conditions as it may determine and shall perform his functions under general
directions of the Board.
(2) The Director‑General
,shall be responsible for the maintenance of good order and discipline.
(3) The Director‑General
shall be the principal accounting officer of the Academy.

Appointment of the officers and members of the staff of the academy

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
12. Appointment of the officers and members of the staff of the Academy.‑‑(1)
Officers and members of the staff of the Academy may be appointed either by
direct recruitment, transfer, deputation or otherwise, on such terms and
conditions, as may be determined by the Board.
(2) The Director‑General
may‑‑
(a) on the recommendation of a
Selection Committee constituted by the Board,. appoint members of the staff to
posts in Basic Pay Scales up to 16; and
(b) on the recommendation of a
Selection Committee constituted by the Board, and with the prior approval of
the Chairman, appoint officers to posts in Basic Pay Scales 17 and above.

Fund of the academy

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
13 Fund of the
Academy.‑‑(1) Government may, from time to time place funds at
the disposal of the Academy for smooth discharge of its functions and the
efficient conduct of its affairs.
(2) The Academy may also be
financed from the following sources.
(i) grants from the Federal and Provincial
Governments;
(ii) scale or royalties of its publications; and
(iii) aid from national and international agencies.
(3) Funds of the Academy shall
vest in the Academy, and may be kept in the personal ledger account of the
Academy to be opened in the Government Treasury or, with the approval of the
Chairman in a scheduled bank, and to be operated by the Director‑General.
.

Budget etc

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
14. Budget etc.‑‑(1)
The Director‑General‑ shall, in respect of each financial year,
submit for approval of the Board by such date and in such form as may be
prescribed, a statement showing the estimated receipts, current and development
expenditure and the sums which arc likely to be required from the Government
during the financial year.
(2) The Director‑General
shall not incur any expenditure from the funds which is not provided for in the
budget approved by the Board.
(3) The accounts of the Academy
shall be audited by the Accountant‑ General of Sindh.

Annual reports etc

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
15. Annual reports etc.‑‑(I) Within two months of the
conclusion of each calendar year, the Director‑General shall submit the
annual report to the Board in respect of various activities carried out by the
Academy during the last year, together with the report of the Accountant‑General
of Sindh relating to the accounts of the Academy.
(2) The Board may, from time to
time, submit a report to Government relating to the funds of the Academy and
its programmes.

Regulations

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
16. Regulations.‑‑The Board may make regulations for
carrying out the purposes of this Act.

Removal of difficulties

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
I7. Removal of difficulties.‑‑If arty difficulty arises in
giving effect to arty provision of this Act, the Board may make such order, not
inconsistent with the express provisions of this Act, as may appear to it to be
necessary or expedient for the purpose of removing the difficulty.

Repeal of Sindh Ordinance no.  XVIII of 1993

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
SINDH JUDICIAL ACADEMY ACT,
1993 .
18. Repeat of Sindh Ordinance No.XVIII of 1993.‑‑The Sin&
Judicial Academy ordinance, 1993, is hereby. repealed.
